verdict.rationale: Gitea ships its own automation engine, Gitea Actions: YAML workflows compatible with GitHub Actions, run by an official action runner, with autoscaling runners offered on the managed tier. That counts as product-native background automation. The evidence does not show recurring or scheduled triggers, how unattended runs behave, or any AI or agentic automation, so only the core CI/CD automation is established. Missing for 10: documented scheduled/recurring triggers, evidence of autonomous agent-style automations, hands-on corroboration of unattended background runs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Gitea Actions supports CI/CD functionality, compatible with GitHub Actions. Users can write workflows in familiar YAML format and reuse a variety of existing Actions plugins.
an action runner for Gitea Action
